neighbours.label: Attribution of a statement to a source in reported speech
fire: The bridge could remain closed for months, the engineer has warned.
The proposed tax would hurt small shops, the minister has claimed.
The water contains unsafe levels of lead, the report noted.
The new timetable will begin in June, officials said on Tuesday.
The repairs should cost less than expected, she added during the meeting.
The mayor will seek another term, sources familiar with the campaign said.
He also argued that the plan would save money over several years.
The software exposes private records, the researchers have warned.
quiet: The bridge could remain closed for months because its foundations are damaged.
The proposed tax would hurt small shops by increasing their operating costs.
The water contains unsafe levels of lead near the old industrial site.
The new timetable will begin in June with additional services on Tuesday.
The repairs should cost less than expected after the changes during the meeting.
The mayor will seek another term with support from the experienced campaign staff.
He also calculated the money saved by the plan over several years.
The software exposes private records through a poorly secured public endpoint.
